name: taskflow
description: TaskFlow — Vercel deployment root. The client builds to client/dist (served as static assets) and api/index.js runs the Express app as a serverless function.

scripts.build: npm --prefix client ci && npm --prefix client run build

comment: These dependencies mirror server/package.json. Vercel installs the serverless function's dependencies from this root manifest, so both files must be kept in step.
